metadata.scenario: A homeowner calls to get a pricing proposal for a home renovation project. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I’m calling to get a pricing proposal for a home renovation project. Oh, I see. Just to clarify, are you looking for our healthcare services or... No, I mean a renovation for my home. Ah, I apologize for that misunderstanding. We're primarily a healthcare agency. Right, I know. I just thought you might have some recommendations or know someone who does renovations. Unfortunately, we don't handle renovations, but I can guide you on our healthcare services if you're interested. Actually, I’d appreciate that. I've been needing reassurance about my IV therapy lately, too. Of course, Mary. You’ve been receiving long-term IV antibiotic therapy from us, right? Yes, for about four months now due to my bone infection. I understand how anxious medical procedures can make you feel. Yes, I really need caregivers who can reassure me during the process. We can definitely work on matching you with caregivers who provide that level of comfort. That would be great, thank you. Can you give me a quote on the IV therapy services? Sure, our IV therapy administration ranges from $120 to $150 for each visit. And how long do those sessions usually last? Each session typically lasts about 1 to 2 hours, depending on the treatment. That sounds reasonable. Is there any flexibility in pricing for long-term clients? We can certainly discuss a package deal for long-term therapy. Would you like me to draft up options for you? Yes, please! That would help a lot. Great! I’ll also make a note to connect you with caregivers who can provide that reassurance. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate that. You’re welcome, Mary. So I'll prepare a quote and caregiver options for you. Perfect! When can I expect to receive that? I’ll have it ready by tomorrow afternoon at the latest. That works for me. Thank you again for your help! Absolutely, Mary! If you have any more questions, don't hesitate to call. I will. Have a great day, Margaret! You too, Mary! Take care.
